summary: Pictures Nora is not in no longer take on her own 3D mascot look, and her image prompts stick to what was asked.
details: Her appearance and rendering rules now apply only when she is in the picture. Otherwise the style comes from the request, or from the room when the request names none.

She adds setting, props or lighting only when they serve the request, and describes the scene so it could physically exist. Before this, «a cat sleeping on a laptop» gained a desk, a lamp and a night room, and the laptop came out closed.
She tells the image model there is no text unless the picture needs words, so captions nobody asked for (like «Hello Nora!» on a screen) stay out.
limitations: The updated eval case (no mascot styling on a picture she is not in) has not been run yet.
The skill ships in the image: a rebuild is needed for it to reach production.
